svg.text: Three V3 packages → three independent building Blueprints
AuraProj • 14 September 2026 • Additive import; existing buildings and maps preserved
BEFORE Three external ZIP packages; no V3 building assets in AuraProj.
AFTER Package-local meshes and PBR maps → complete Actor Blueprint → drag into any level.
One truncated moss ORM regenerated manually from
intact AO / Roughness / Metallic; channels match exactly.
South Gate: projected UVs; original geometry preserved.
Named rotation axes. LODs and modules stay as supporting assets.
Fresh Unreal process: load, spawn, transforms, collision and package-local dependency closure.
Six front/rear captures reviewed · 234 PNGs checked · 419 pre-existing assets/maps unchanged.
40 mesh sources · 348 meshes · 189 textures · 25 building materials · 3 standalone Actor Blueprints
